subject: Polish AHS Krab self-propelled howitzer serving with an unnamed Ukrainian artillery brigade
date_scope: Publication date; Commons lists this date for the photograph. Exact capture date not independently specified.
place: Ukraine; exact location not disclosed. ArmyInform report describes the brigade in eastern Ukraine and service in Donetsk, Luhansk, Kharkiv and Kherson regions.
credit: ArmyInform / Ukrainian Ministry of Defence; article credits photographs and video to the author and brigade press service.
asset_edits: None; original JPEG downloaded. If display crops with object-fit, attribution should state cropped for display.
recommended_visible_caption: Polish Krab in Ukraine · South Korean K9 chassis
recommended_alt: Front view of a Polish AHS Krab howitzer serving with Ukrainian artillery, using a chassis derived from South Korea’s K9.

lineage_sources.finding: Manufacturer confirms Hanwha supplied the K9 chassis for Poland’s AHS Krab development and manufacture.
Official Polish report: Krab chassis bought from Hanwha in 2014; initial chassis imported, later chassis to be made by HSW in Poland; technology-transfer agreement signed at ADEX 2017.
Manufacturer reiterates 2014 selection of K9 chassis for the Polish Krab.

speaker_note: South Korean arms technology is already part of Ukraine’s defense: Poland’s Krab howitzer uses a chassis based on the South Korean K9. This photograph shows the Polish weapon in Ukrainian service. It does not depict a direct South Korean government delivery, or a wholly Korean-made howitzer.
flags_recommendation: ROK → Poland → Ukraine, or ROK and Ukrainian flags with the explicit caption identifying the Polish Krab intermediary.
